title: Uruguayan permanent residence for nationals of Mercosur member and associated states

sources.title: Ley N.º 18.250 (migration law), article 33 B): nationals of Mercosur member and associated states who prove that nationality are permanent residents
Ley N.º 20.075, article 169: the current text of article 33, in force 120 days after its promulgation on 2022-10-20
Decreto N.º 45/023, article 2: the national applies with a valid passport or identity document, before the Ministry of the Interior or a consulate
Dirección Nacional de Migración, Residencia legal: Mercosur permanent residence for nationals of AR, BO, BR, CL, CO, EC, GY, PE, PY, SR and VE

requirements.title: Holds the nationality of a Mercosur member or associated state: Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname or Venezuela
